detail: Country names renamed to common English names (helps Power BI map geocoding)
Rows where deaths > confirmed or confirmed > population
total_deaths blank -> 0 (blank means no deaths reported); flagged in deaths_assumed_zero
total_recovered & active_cases left as NaN (cannot be inferred); flagged in recovery_data_missing
serious_or_critical left as NaN (81 blanks = not reported); excluded from analysis
total_tests / tests_per_1m left as NaN; testing-based metrics skipped for these rows
Recovered < 50% of cases in a country with >=1,000 cases: recovery feed looks stale; active_cases overstated
Total tests < confirmed cases (likely counts people/lab-batches differently or partial reporting)
Population < 1M: per-million metrics are volatile; excluded from correlations & rankings
cfr_pct, infection_rate_pct, cases/deaths/tests per 1M (recomputed from raw counts), tests_per_case, cumulative_positivity_pct, active_share_pct, recovery_rate_pct
Category columns for slicers: population_size, testing_tier, cfr_band, burden_tier; analysis_sample = pop>=1M & cases>=1,000
